environment: One regional managed Enterprise trial instance, existing GoogleSQL database, read-only. Local container platforms are recorded below.

baseline_database_scope.google-stats: same input SQL, previously run on a disposable GoogleSQL database

changed_query.sql: SELECT SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_PERCENTILE(SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(LATENCY_DISTRIBUTION_JSON_STRING), 99.0) AS p99 FROM SPANNER_SYS.QUERY_STATS_TOP_MINUTE WHERE INTERVAL_END > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
changed_query.service_detail: Distribution-json-string input to SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_PERCENTILE function cannot be NULL or EMPTY.

distribution_controls.label: rolling-original
distribution_controls.sql: SELECT SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_PERCENTILE(SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(LATENCY_DISTRIBUTION_JSON_STRING), 99.0) AS p99 FROM SPANNER_SYS.QUERY_STATS_TOP_MINUTE WHERE INTERVAL_END > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)

distribution_controls.label: rolling-count-and-guard
distribution_controls.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(LATENCY_DISTRIBUTION_JSON_STRING) AS nonnull, SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(LATENCY_DISTRIBUTION_JSON_STRING) AS h FROM SPANNER_SYS.QUERY_STATS_TOP_MINUTE WHERE INTERVAL_END > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)) SELECT n, nonnull, h IS NULL AS null_hist, IF(h IS NULL,NULL,SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_PERCENTILE(h,99.0)) AS p99 FROM a

distribution_controls.label: empty
distribution_controls.sql: SELECT SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_PERCENTILE(SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(LATENCY_DISTRIBUTION_JSON_STRING), 99.0) AS p99 FROM SPANNER_SYS.QUERY_STATS_TOP_MINUTE WHERE FALSE

distribution_controls.label: empty-count-and-guard
distribution_controls.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(LATENCY_DISTRIBUTION_JSON_STRING) AS h FROM SPANNER_SYS.QUERY_STATS_TOP_MINUTE WHERE FALSE) SELECT n,h IS NULL AS null_hist,IF(h IS NULL,NULL,SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_PERCENTILE(h,99.0)) AS p99 FROM a

distribution_controls.label: fixed-sample
distribution_controls.sql: SELECT SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_PERCENTILE(SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(hist),99.0) AS p99 FROM UNNEST(['{"BUCKET_COUNTS":[-10,1],"COUNT":1,"GROWTH_FACTOR":2.0,"MEAN":647.0,"NUM_FINITE_BUCKETS":33,"SCALE":1.0,"SUM_OF_SQUARED_DEVIATION":0.0}']) AS hist

queries.label: placement/catalog-tables
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='INFORMATION_SCHEMA' AND STRPOS(TABLE_NAME,'PLACEMENT')>0 ORDER BY TABLE_NAME

queries.label: placement/catalog-columns
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='INFORMATION_SCHEMA' AND STRPOS(TABLE_NAME,'PLACEMENT')>0 ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.label: placement/option-positive-control
queries.sql: SELECT OPTION_NAME,OPTION_TYPE,OPTION_VALUE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.DATABASE_OPTIONS WHERE LOWER(OPTION_NAME)='database_dialect'

fixture_order: In a fresh GoogleSQL database, run bulk_setup, the 16 bulk_privileges.forms for tables, views, change streams and sequences, default_schema_usage, the remaining eight bulk forms for functions, and bulk_final_controls. These first 41 steps use an administrator connection.

Open a second fresh GoogleSQL database. Submit individual_function.setup as one DDL batch. Run the seven controls under individual_function.omni in the listed order, using udf_reader for the before, after-grant and after-revoke queries.

bulk_setup.sql: CREATE TABLE T (Id INT64) PRIMARY KEY (Id)
CREATE VIEW V SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS SELECT 1 AS Id
CREATE CHANGE STREAM Changes FOR T
CREATE FUNCTION inventory.f(x INT64) RETURNS INT64 SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS (x + 1)

default_schema_usage.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA DEFAULT TO ROLE role1
REVOKE USAGE ON SCHEMA DEFAULT FROM ROLE role1

bulk_final_controls.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA inventory TO ROLE role1
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION inventory.f TO ROLE role1
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION inventory.f FROM ROLE role1
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION inventory.missing TO ROLE role1
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION inventory.missing FROM ROLE role1
